annotation.unknown_reason: The obligations require identifying the channel with the smallest number of messages and determining which users are not already in that channel, then specifying their membership in both the global users list and the user_channels mapping. The initial state provides all channel message counts and user memberships, but the obligations require post-state membership for users who were initially absent from the least-message channel. Without the resolved expected channel name and user list (which are not disclosed in the public metadata), the required POST-condition fields cannot be derived safely. The contract cannot be constructed without leaking or assuming the undisclosed resolved values.
